Strong communication skills: You can write clearly and make persuasive technical arguments. Preferred Experience with BaaS platforms (Supabase, Firebase, Railway, Hasura, or similar) Familiarity with AI-native coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) Healthcare domain knowledge (HIPAA, EPCS, PDMP, EHR/EMR systems) Front-end expertise (React, TypeScript, Next.js, or similar) Compensation The base salary range for this role is competitive and will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, and geographic location. About VITL VITL is a Nashville-based healthtech company providing beautifully simple e-prescribing infrastructure for cash-pay medical practices.
